name: 10-happier
title: 10% Happier: How I Tamed the Voice in My Head, Reduced Stress Without Losing My Edge, and Found Self-Help That Actually Works
author: Dan Harris
description: Dan Harris's "10% Happier" — a skeptic's guide to meditation from an ABC news anchor who had a panic attack on live TV. Covers meditation for skeptics, anxiety management, how to start meditating in 5 minutes, mindfulness for workplace performance, and self-compassion.
